title: X Launches @bot Tagging for First Direct Grok Bot Control in Replies

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
A new integration on X allows people to command an AI agent to manage their reading lists or summarize threads by replying to any post. This system utilizes a specialized handle to send instructions to the Grok Bot, which executes the task and delivers the result directly to the person's AI interface.

The feature supports functions such as drafting replies, setting reminders to read content later, and exporting information to Notion reading lists. The tagging capability is active across all replies, posts, and quote posts, transforming the public feed into a command line for the platform's AI assistant.
